*   **The Vibe:** Unlike a standard *Chudail*, a **Yakshi** is a forest spirit. In South Indian folklore, they are beautiful women who appear in dense forests at night. They aren't just "scary"—they are mystical. Some are kind, some are deadly.

Owner replies:  “Phir passenger seat par mitti kaise hai?”  Amit looks inside. Passenger-side floor wet and muddy.  He leaves immediately. Through the curtain he can hear a 90s television serial playing.  Then advertisements.  Then the old Doordarshan-style tone.  He looks through a crack. Then Vivek finds a framed photograph.  It's the same family he saw.  Except one additional child appears in the photograph.  Vivek recognizes him.  It's his childhood friend standing next to him.  His friend says he's never entered the house.  Then from deeper inside the house, an old television turns on.  On screen is grainy footage of the living room they're currently standing in.  They can see themselves.  Live.  Vivek and his friend.  But the screen shows someone standing behind them.  They turn.  Nothing.  Look at television again.  The figure has moved closer. Your job is simply to tell the story so well that for 15 minutes the viewer wants to know what happens next.
